# Introducing Cricut Maker® 5: The Next Generation of Cricut’s Ultimate Smart Cutting Machine


-
-
-


3 September 2026


[Cricut](https://cricut.com/blog/author/cricut/)


---


Cricut Maker® 5 is the next generation of our ultimate smart cutting machine, designed for makers who want the widest range of creative possibilities in one machine. From custom, full-color stickers to personalized apparel, engraved keepsakes, unique fabric appliques, and more, Cricut Maker® 5 gives you the freedom to make more than ever before, while taking up 30% less space than previous models.


Whether you’re shopping for your first Cricut machine or wondering if it’s time to upgrade, here’s everything you need to know about Cricut Maker® 5.


## What’s new with Cricut Maker® 5?


Cricut Maker® 5 builds on everything makers love about the previous models while introducing meaningful updates that make creating even easier.


Highlights include:


- 30% more compact machine than previous models
- Updated engraving tool*
- New Scoring Tool
- Cut and engrave materials up to 3 mm thick*
- A hassle-free snap-in pen holder for quicker pen changes
- New Load & Go™ functionality
- More intuitive making experience in Design Space®


## Cut and engrave thicker materials up to 3mm


Ready to move beyond paper and vinyl? Cricut Maker® 5 works with compatible thicker materials up to 3 mm* to give you the flexibility to create more projects that previous cutting machines simply couldn’t achieve.


Cut specialty materials up to 3 mm thick, like leather, cardboard, foam core, corrugated plastic, and more.


Engrave materials up to 3 mm thick, like acrylic, leather, wood, and metal.


## A more compact design for everyday making spaces


Big creative possibilities shouldn’t require a big work space. Cricut Maker® 5 features a redesigned body that’s 30% smaller than previous Cricut Maker® machines to fit on desks, shelves, craft carts, or shared workspaces.


Small design improvements also make everyday creating smoother, including:


- Faster Load & Go™ workflows
- Snap-in pen loading
- Simplified controls
- Cleaner project workflows in Design Space™


Whether you have a dedicated craft room or a corner of the kitchen table, Cricut Maker® 5 is designed to fit your space and your routine.


## Create with over 300 materials and 13 specialty tools*


Cricut Maker machines are known for their unique versatility, working with over 300 compatible materials, including classic crafting materials like vinyl, iron-on (HTV), and cardstock, as well as specialty materials like fabric, leather, wood, acrylic, and so much more.


With 13 compatible tools (sold separately depending on the bundle you choose), Cricut Maker 5 is still the most versatile cutting machine in our portfolio. It cuts, engraves, writes, draws, foils, scores, debosses, and more, so you can make the widest range of projects with just one machine.


### Cricut Maker® 5 specialty tools


- Fine Point Cutting Tool: Cuts designs and shapes from paper, iron-on, vinyl, and more
- Deep Cutting Tool: Cuts thicker material like posterboard and craft foam
- Scoring Tool: Creates crisp guidelines for folded cards, origami, and more
- Knife Blade: Cuts materials up to 3 mm thick like chipboard and balsa wood
- Rotary Blade: Glides through cotton, fleece, denim, and more
- Foil Transfer Tool: Embellishes cards, gift tags, and more with a foil finish
- Debossing Tool: Leaves design impression on leather, softwood, and more
- Engraving Tool: Inscribes design in metal, leather, plastic, and more
- Wavy Blade: Adds a wavy edge to paper, vinyl, and more
- Bonded-Fabric Blade: Easily cuts through bonded fabric
- Single Scoring Wheel: Create score lines for perfect folds and finishes
- Double Scoring Wheel: Creates extra-deep score lines for perfect folds
- Perforation Blade: Creates uniform, finely perforated lines

## Where to buy Cricut Maker® 5


Cricut Maker® 5 will be available beginning September 4, 2026, in a Slate Blue color on Cricut.com or in an exclusive Teal color only at Michaels.


Ready to start making?[Shop Cricut Maker® 5](https://cricut.com/en-us/cutting-machines/cricut-maker/cricut-maker-5/cricut-maker-5/2012940.html) to explore machine options, bundles, compatible tools, and materials. Or[compare Cricut machines](https://cricut.com/en-us/machine-comparison/machines-compare.html) to find the one that’s right for your creative goals.


## Frequently Asked Questions


####


Cricut Maker® 5 is the next generation of our 12-inch smart cutting machine. It offers the widest range of creative capabilities of the Cricut cutting machine lineup, including compatibility with 300+ materials and 13 tools, and works with thicker material up to 3 mm to cut, engrave, deboss, score, Print-Then-Cut, and more.*


*Cricut Maker 5 requires compatible computer or mobile device with Bluetooth® wireless and high-speed internet connection – system requirements may change. Average size of project is 4 in x 6 in (10.2 cm x 15.2 cm) using included materials. Compatible materials, tools & accessories sold separately. Full content library & certain software features requires paid Cricut Access™ subscription. Tools shown may differ in box. All machines include pre-installed cutting blade—either with metal housing or new Cutting Tool. Pens are water based, acid-free; conforms to ASTM-D4236. Limited Warranty – see Cricut website, or write to manufacturer or authorized region representative at applicable address, for full terms and conditions. Visit Cricut website for specific compatibility, details, terms and conditions, warranty information, and more. The Bluetooth® word mark and logos are registered trademarks owned by Bluetooth SIG, Inc. and any use of such marks by Cricut, Inc. is under license. Cricut Maker 5 is not intended for use by children 12 years and younger.


####


Cricut Maker® 5 introduces a redesigned, 30% more compact footprint compared to previous models. It also works with thicker materials to cut and engrave materials up to 3 mm. Improved Load & Go™ workflows for faster making, a hassle-free snap-in pen holder, enhanced Print-Then-Cut capability, and project workflow improvements make creating faster and easier than ever before.


####


Yes. Cricut Maker® 5 can cut and engrave compatible materials* up to 3 mm thick, including materials like leather, foam core, corrugated plastic, cardboard, and acrylic.


####


Yes. Cricut Maker® 5 is a great choice for beginners who want one machine that can grow with their creative ambitions. It makes everyday projects like full-color stickers, cards, labels, and iron-on for apparel easy to achieve while offering advanced capabilities to explore as your skills grow.


####


If you’re interested in working with thicker-material projects, taking on engraving projects, expanding tool compatibility, or a smaller machine (compared to previous generations of Cricut Maker machines) with improved workflows, Cricut Maker® 5 is a compelling upgrade. If you primarily make occasional simple projects, a different Cricut cutting machine may better meet your needs.


####


You can create everything from vinyl decals, labels, cards, stickers, and iron-on for apparel to engraved keepsakes, acrylic ornaments, leather accessories, fabric projects, debossed stationery, and thicker-material home décor. With Cricut Maker® 5 you can personalize without limits and bring all your ideas to life.


####


Cricut Maker® 5 launches September 4, 2026, and is available for purchase on Cricut.com and in-store at Michaels. The exclusive Teal color is available only at Michaels, and the Slate Blue color is available at Cricut.com.
